about:
DevOps Engineer with 2 years of hands-on DevOps experience and over 6 years in IT and system administration. Skilled in Linux, Windows Server, Bash scripting, Python, PHP-FPM, MySQL, CI/CD, and full-stack tool development. Experienced in designing, developing, and deploying automation and monitoring solutions.

Currently expanding cloud expertise through AWS certifications and professional development courses, with a strong focus on automation, infrastructure optimization, and operational efficiency. I am dedicated to examining open-source projects, staying up-to-date with emerging technologies, and contributing thoughtfully to team-oriented projects.

description: Manage both online and offline systems including updates, installations, and operational support across multiple servers.
Automate repetitive server tasks and monitoring processes using Bash and Python, significantly improving operational efficiency and reducing manual errors.
Apply expertise in Linux, PHP-FPM, and MySQL to maintain system stability and optimize performance.
Designed and developed DevOps Lab, a full-stack tool for automated server backups, remote command execution, and real-time monitoring of server metrics.
Provided comprehensive technical support for Linux, Windows Server, CentOS, Plesk, cPanel, DirectAdmin, VMware, Hyper-V, PHP , ASP .NET , and WordPress environments.

Independently designed, developed, and deployed SizeChecker, a full-stack solution for tracking reseller hosting email usage. Windows Service built in C#, and web interface developed with PHP , JavaScript, and MySQL, enabling previously untrackable metrics to be accurately monitored and reported.
Strengthened problem-solving, communication, and server management skills while handling high-volume support requests.
